summary: Adds three playable jMonkeyEngine games to the New Project screen: a 3D demo, Block Game and Bubble Wand.
description: Installs three small Android game projects built with jMonkeyEngine, so you can start from a complete, playable game instead of an empty activity. Demo is a 3D Earth you spin by touch with an orbiting rocket, written in Java. Block Game is a falling-block puzzle and Bubble Wand is a first-person bubble shooter, both written in Kotlin. Each project builds and runs on the device.
